feeds.title: Oh My! Omaha
feeds.description: Kim, a passionate mom, wife, writer, and coffee aficionado, cherishes Omaha while embracing the excitement of travel. Through 'Oh My! Omaha,' her blog, she delves into Omaha's attractions, dining, and travel gems, inspiring families worldwide. Her journey celebrates the extraordinary both at home and abroad, inviting all to explore and savour life's adventures. Discover more at ohmyomaha.com.

feeds.title: An Affair from the Heart
feeds.description: I'm Michaela. I pride myself on sharing tried and true recipes of all kinds that use simple ingredients, nothing crazy you can't pronounce, that you might happen to have right in your own kitchen.

feeds.title: CapitalMOM
feeds.description: CapitalMOM is Bryan Health's online community for Nebraska parents and grandparents to connect with one another and learn about the joys of parenting.

feeds.title: Mom Saves Money
feeds.description: Nicole resides near Omaha, Nebraska, with her husband and three children. Mom Saves Money offers invaluable insights into saving money, a passion Nicole cultivated since 2008. Her blog reflects her dedication to sharing money-saving tips and discoveries, enriching the lives of others through financial empowerment.

feeds.title: Gastronom Blog
feeds.description: Hi, we are Jay and Leah, a couple who love to share our love of cocktails, great food, restaurants, and spirited travel! Both of us love to entertain, and believe that food and drink not only nourish us but feed the soul! Here on Gastronom Cocktails, you'll not only find dessert and dinner recipes but also cocktails and alcohol recipes. We have also spiced it up with our travel experiences.

feeds.title: Nebraska Hockey Mom
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Tonya! I am a middle school teaching mom of 4 hockey players, aged from 9 to 18! We LIVE at the ice rink! I designed this blog as a hobby for people to see real life...life at the ice rink...and have reviews and giveaways!

feeds.title: Rachelle Lee Photography Blog
feeds.description: Rachelle Warner is a Portrait & Lifestyle photographer in Central Nebraska, offering custom, on-location photography.

feeds.title: Jennifer Griswold Reports
feeds.description: A blog by Jennifer Griswold about motherhood and managing a career and family.

feeds.title: Home With The Boys
feeds.description: I'm Erin, a wife, boy mom x 3, writer, and runner in Nebraska! I'm excited to share all my favorites relating to faith, family, fashion, and fitness in this space!

feeds.title: The Miller Memo
feeds.description: I'm Shaye. I'm a Teacher Librarian, mom to 5 Littles, a reader, writer/blogger, and adjunct faculty at Chadron State College. My posts are usually about kid literature, young adult literature, educational technology, library science, and more.

feeds.title: Nebraska Odyssey Blog
feeds.description: My name is Gretchen Garrison, and I am a teacher/mom who enjoys exploring Nebraska places and people, both past and present. Join our recent adventures.

feeds.title: The Work at Home Wife
feeds.description: Helping women find work from home jobs and home-based business ideas. Learn how to make extra money from home today. Founded by Angie Nelson.

feeds.title: Chelsie Morales
feeds.description: I'm Chelsie. I'm a full time working mama to a wild little man and wifey to Will. I hope my blog will inspire you, make you laugh, and ultimately realize life is one hell of a ride, might as well have fun on it!
